standard.scoring: Score VPs equal to Enemy Supply destroyed this Round. End of Round 5: gain 4 VP for each Friendly Unit that CLAIMS a Mission Marker and is Wholly Within Friendly Zone of Influence. Gain 2 VP for each Mission Marker associated with your colour that is not currently CLAIMED by an Enemy Unit.
standard.additional: Scoring Phase: from the Start of the second Round, if a Unit is Within 3″ of a Controlled Mission Marker that is Neutral or associated with the Opponent colour, that Unit may CLAIM it. CLAIM: place the Mission Marker on the Unit Card. A Unit carrying a Mission Marker must DROP it if: it has its Current Supply Value reduced; before it resolves a PLACE effect; it is Engaged with Enemies having a greater combined Current Supply Value; it is Destroyed, removed from the battlefield, or returned to Reserves. When a Unit DROPS a Mission Marker, the Opponent places it Within 2″ of the Unit or its last model removed. A Unit may CLAIM only one Mission Marker at a time.

skirmish.scoring: Score VPs equal to Enemy Supply destroyed this Round. End of Round 5: gain 3 VP for each Friendly Unit that CLAIMS a Mission Marker and is Wholly Within Friendly Zone of Influence. Gain 1 VP for each Mission Marker associated with your colour that is not currently CLAIMED by an Enemy Unit.
skirmish.additional: Same CLAIM and DROP rules as Standard: from Round 2, a Unit Within 3″ of a Controlled Neutral or Opponent-colour Marker may CLAIM it (place it on the Unit Card). DROP it if its Current Supply Value is reduced, before it resolves a PLACE effect, if Engaged with Enemies of greater combined Current Supply, or if Destroyed, removed or returned to Reserves. The Opponent places a DROPPED Marker Within 2″. One CLAIM per Unit.
